tip: For an acute angle in a right triangle: P = opposite, B = adjacent, H = hypotenuse. Example: Also: 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ; 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.
explanation: For an acute angle in a right triangle: P = opposite, B = adjacent, H = hypotenuse.
example: Also: 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ; 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.
